name: iomarkets-topup
description: Buy real-world goods for your principal with USDC on Algorand via x402: mobile airtime and data top-ups in 150+ countries, delivered to any phone number. No account, no card, no API key. Money settles on-chain before anything is bought, failed deliveries are refunded on-chain automatically, and every terminal order carries an ed25519-signed receipt naming both transactions. eSIMs, prepaid bills and international payouts are built but supplier-gated — GET /v1/catalog is the live answer.
